description: This file implements ELF extension loading, symbol resolution, section mapping, and relocation for Zephyr RTOS, specifically handling ELF binaries for extensions or modules.

methods.name: llext_find_section
methods.description: Finds a section by name in the ELF loader context.

methods.name: llext_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves an extension by its name from the global list.

methods.name: llext_iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all loaded extensions, applying a callback function.

methods.name: llext_find_sym
methods.description: Finds a symbol address in a symbol table or built-in symbols.

methods.name: llext_find_tables
methods.description: Finds symbol and string tables in the ELF binary.

methods.name: llext_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string from a section based on index.

methods.name: llext_map_sections
methods.description: Maps ELF sections to internal memory regions.

methods.name: llext_init_mem_part
methods.description: Initializes memory partitions for extension sections.

methods.name: llext_copy_section
methods.description: Copies a section from ELF to memory, allocating if necessary.

methods.name: llext_copy_strings
methods.description: Copies string and symbol table sections.

methods.name: llext_copy_sections
methods.description: Copies all relevant sections from ELF.

methods.name: llext_count_export_syms
methods.description: Counts exported symbols in the ELF.

methods.name: llext_allocate_symtab
methods.description: Allocates memory for the symbol table.

methods.name: llext_export_symbols
methods.description: Exports symbols to the extension's symbol table.

methods.name: llext_copy_symbols
methods.description: Copies symbols from ELF to internal symbol table.

methods.name: llext_file_offset
methods.description: Calculates file offset for a given section offset.

methods.name: arch_elf_relocate_local
methods.description: Weak function for local relocation, architecture-specific.

methods.name: llext_link_plt
methods.description: Links the PLT (Procedure Linkage Table) for ELF.

methods.name: arch_elf_relocate
methods.description: Weak function for ELF relocation, architecture-specific.

methods.name: llext_link
methods.description: Performs ELF linking and relocation for an extension.

methods.name: do_llext_load
methods.description: Loads a valid ELF as an extension, performing all necessary steps.

methods.name: llext_load
methods.description: Main function to load an ELF extension by name.

methods.name: llext_unload
methods.description: Unloads a loaded extension, freeing resources.

methods.name: llext_call_fn
methods.description: Calls a function symbol within an extension.

methods.name: llext_add_domain
methods.description: Adds extension memory regions to a memory domain (if supported).
